note: Primary: Questing Goose Studio Steam announcement '200,000 Units Sold!' 28 Oct 2026 18:30Z: 200,000 copies in the first few hours, 86,000+ peak concurrent players within 90 minutes, 95% positive from 400+ reviews, #2 Global Top Sellers. Steam store 29 Oct 09:20Z: Overwhelmingly Positive (97% of 1,371), released 28 Oct 2026, Windows only, publisher tinyBuild; SteamDB peak 86,099. Footage: Steam Launch trailer 1080p60 5.7 Mbps, decode clean, no speech (faster-whisper empty); shots on centred subjects, AVAILABLE NOW slate from 88 s avoided; card ground on a customer at the counter (65.7 s); the Thief shot (58.4 s) carries the game's own speech bubble, judged on the sheet. Track: one stretch of the trailer's music from 21.0 s (steady level after the title beat). v3: closing shot moved off the key art (an AVAILABLE NOW slate burns in from 86.5 s; the smear check caught it); the last two shots carry no line.
